findings.message: 6 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01 / THE PHILOSOPHY", "02 / WHAT WE DO", "01", "02", "03", "03 / THE LOOKBOOK"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 5 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "TEXTURE-LED HAIRCARE", "01 / THE PHILOSOPHY", "02 / WHAT WE DO", "03 / THE LOOKBOOK").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.
